title: Human Services payroll missed premiums in both directions

beats.text: San Francisco pays premiums for bilingual services.

visual.sub: The agency paid at least $8,840 without evidence of timely bilingual certification

beats.text: Auditors found at least $8,840 without proof of timely certification.

visual.kicker: The agency paid at least $8,840 without evidence of timely bilingual certification

beats.text: A separate review sampled 25 emergency response workers.

visual.kicker: Five sampled workers received emergency response premiums without proper authorization

beats.text: Five received premiums without proper authorization.
In longevity pay, fourteen employees received too much.

visual.kicker: Longevity errors shortchanged more workers than they overpaid

beats.text: Sixteen missed an estimated $9,984 they should have received.
The underpayment is separate from the $18,957 auditors questioned.

visual.kicker: Longevity errors shortchanged more workers than they overpaid

beats.text: The department reported implementing all 14 recommendations.

visual.kicker: The Controller closed its follow-up after the agency reported implementation

beats.text: Another audit found a $20 underpayment on a bilingual premium.
Payroll submitted a correction form when the auditors requested records.
